existing_site.notes: This is an upgrade proposal for the existing Wix site at imsblasting.com (HTTP 200). The public sitemap lists only / and /shop. Current nav is HOME, SERVICES, ABOUT, GALLERY, CONTACT, BUY ABRASIVES, where the first five are single-page anchors. The upgrade preserves those labels and order but turns each into its own static page. The shop ('Abrasives') has 10 products, and this preview shows only 3, all marked New Arrival on the shop cards. Wix account, cart, and checkout routes exist but are not reproduced. The contact form was not submitted and is not replicated as a working form. Footer social links are Facebook and TikTok, with the text '© 2026 by Industrial Mineral Supply.' The contact block also prints '1944 Griffith Blvd. Suite C', and the header form '1944 N. Griffith Blvd. Suite C' is used. flowbite-vue was chosen because the business is primarily a blasting and painting service with phone quotes; the abrasives shop is presented as a static 3-item sample using Flowbite cards.
